image_description: A stylized, artistic image featuring three Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor) against a textured, light background. The central fish is the most prominent, displaying the characteristic black anterior and yellow posterior coloration. Two other fish are visible on the left, partially obscured or in shadow. The image contains overlay text elements, including numbers at the top, a block of text in the center, and the word 'ROCKBEAUTY' at the bottom.
